summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of MELATI Program Hub. Backend: 41/41 pytest tests pass covering auth (all 3 roles), users CRUD, programs/indicators CRUD, dashboard (monthly/triwulanan/tahunan), full report workflow (create -> draft save with autosave -> submit -> perbaikan requested -> resubmit -> approved -> comment -> arahan creating follow-up), follow-ups CRUD, tables CRUD with formula column, analyses (list, no-data error correctly returned 400 for 2020-01, validation flow by PJ then Kepala resulting in 'tervalidasi'), presentations list + PPTX/PDF export, report DOCX/XLSX/PDF export (single + kolektif), notifications, settings read/update, integrations/status, cron endpoint (401 without bearer, 401 wrong token, 200 with valid secret), reminders run + logs, activity log role-gating (admin/kepala allowed, PJ 403). Frontend: Login works for all 3 roles; role-based sidebar correct (admin sees Pengguna+Aktivitas; kepala sees Aktivitas but no Pengguna; PJ sees neither). Dashboard renders KPI cards with 'Belum tersedia' placeholders for unreported Oct 2026 data, trend chart, kelengkapan panel. Analysis page shows existing SWOT for KIA Sept 2026 with Fakta tags, sumber, validation UI (shows 'Tervalidasi PJ & Kepala Puskesmas' after both validate). Pengingat page shows integration status cards (Email/AI/Scheduler) and jadwal + logs. Ekspor page shows Word/Excel/PDF buttons + PPTX/PDF for presentation (Triwulan III 2026 presentation visible). Kepala's Tindak Lanjut board shows the follow-up created from backend test (title 'TEST Perbaikan cakupan'). Mobile viewport 390px shows menu button and vertical layout.

issues: Recharts logs harmless console warning 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on initial render before container measures - no user impact

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 965 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, reports, analyses, exports) for maintainability
In recap.py: line 215-216 in dashboard() has a duplicate assignment of row['bulan'] (first with ternary, then overwritten) - harmless but confusing
/api/cron/reminders uses os.environ['WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET'] which will KeyError (500) if not set instead of raising 401 - acceptable since it's required for operation
PJ role can see 'Pengingat & Integrasi' and 'Program & Indikator' sidebar links (read-only on backend thanks to require('admin')); not a bug but could tighten UX by hiding
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is (admin, kepala, pj.kia). All logins succeeded.
seed_data_creation: Backend test workflow created an Aug-2026 KIA report (draf -> diajukan -> perlu_perbaikan -> diajukan -> disetujui) plus a kepala comment, an arahan with follow-up titled 'TEST Perbaikan cakupan' (visible in Tindak Lanjut), a Jul-2026 KIA draft report (used to verify submit-without-capaian error), and a TEST_User account that was created+deleted during user CRUD test. Also validated existing Sept 2026 SWOT analysis so it now reads 'tervalidasi'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~8s with pytest-xdist. All 41 tests green. Server date is Oct 2026 (dashboard default). KIA has Sept 2026 (diajukan originally; now validated SWOT exists), Aug 2026 (disetujui), Jul 2026 (draf) reports after tests. Follow-up 'TEST Perbaikan cakupan' exists in belum-dikerjakan column. Cron secret in backend/.env. Frontend URL env var is correctly used by all pages (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
